# **VoltTrace | System Installation & Deployment Guide**

**Target Platform:** Arduino UNO Q (Dual-Core MCU \+ Linux MPU)

*Before begining, make sure you have done the connections of all sensors,  ac mains and the relay as well, as given in the hardware folder.*

1\. Navigate to the  [repository link](http://github.com/Harshpsbhatti4/VoltTrace) .  
![][image1]  
2\. Download the repository as a .zip file.  
![][image2]  
3\. Download the Arduino App Lab \- [Link](https://www.arduino.cc/en/software/#app-lab-section).

4\. Connect the Arduino Uno Q and open the Arduino App Lab.Once the board is recogisned  click on it.  
![][image3]  
5\. Under the Apps section , click create new app and next click import app.  
![][image4]  
6\. Browse where you hav downloaded the .zip file and select it. Once uploaded the directory will be available in the apps section.  
**![][image5]**

7\. Open the app and hit Run.  
![][image6]  
8\. Once the process is completed, we can view the python terminal and serial monitor as well.  
![][image7]  
![][image8]  
8\. Navigate to [http://127.0.0.1:7000](http://127.0.0.1:7000/). Ensure the device and the arduino uno q must be on the same network in order to view the dashboard.
